# Phase Two — Improved Architecture

> One light enters many keilim, yet the source remains one; Awtsmoos.com should let every specialist reveal its work without pretending the others are gone.

## Canonical facade

`createAwtsmoos(options)` returns an immutable `Awtsmoos` instance with exactly:

- `define(data)` — create/normalize canonical portable semantic definition.
- `validate(definition, options)` — canonical procedural-language validation.
- `plan(definition, request)` — explainable artifact plan using existing semantic kernel/Portal authority.
- `explain(definition, request)` — serializable explanation containing validation, plan, capability/support evidence, and pipeline metadata without executing artifacts.
- `compile(definition, request)` — execute requested supported channels and preserve deferred/diagnostic/provenance truth.

## Expert namespaces

Names should reveal authority, not marketing ambiguity:

- `semantic` — Universal Semantic Kernel.
- `portal` — world Procedural Portal.
- `world` — existing transactional `createUniversalAwtsmoosApi()` runtime over `awtsmoos.world.v1`.
- `compilers` — compiler capability registration/discovery view.
- `diagnostics` — pipeline/explanation helpers if a separate object is useful.

Add more namespaces only when they delegate an existing authority and tests prove a need.

## Lifecycle

1. define / normalize canonical semantic data;
2. validate canonical definition;
3. resolve requested artifact channels and compile policy;
4. consult compiler capabilities and semantic support policy;
5. build artifact plan with cost/LOD/deferred truth;
6. explain selected/rejected compiler chain and diagnostics;
7. compile supported requested channels;
8. validate artifact result shape;
9. preserve definition hash, seed, compiler versions, dependencies, quality policy, channels, and provenance;
10. allow existing caches/transactions/world document layers to own their established responsibilities.

## Why this scales

Domain plugins register semantic capability; they do not add new top-level verbs. A chair, river, arch, creature, city block, or future quantum garden enters the same Definition Graph and differs only by data, traits, relationships, constraints, resources, and compiler capabilities.
